title: Missing lock_timeout — DDL without lock_timeout risks indefinite blocking
migration_snippet:
-- V2__add_index.sql
CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY idx_orders_date ON orders (created_at);
expected_feedback: Critical: DDL missing lock_timeout. Even CONCURRENTLY operations can stall waiting for ShareUpdateExclusiveLock. Because CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY cannot run inside a transaction block, SET LOCAL would only emit a warning and have no effect here -- use session-level SET lock_timeout = '3s' before the statement and RESET lock_timeout afterwards. Keep statement_timeout at 0 for the build itself.
